label: B25-NOFP-BOARD-INTERACTION
title: Volatile configuration and JTAG-UART interaction for the corrected no-FP profile

authorization.user_statement: 好，我们继续，许可使用Quartus和JTAG来烧写和测试设备。
authorization.scope: Quartus/JTAG volatile FPGA configuration and JTAG-UART device testing

scope: Using the proven historical task-owned 15 MHz programmer server and the preserved standard JTAG-UART console path, configure the exact T-006 SOF into volatile SRAM, attach device 1 instance 0 immediately, and exercise boot/status/PING/echo. Preserve all pre-existing servers; stop only task-owned recorded PIDs.
acceptance: Quartus reports volatile configuration success, expected SOF checksum and JTAG ID; console connects and observes LCVEX25 BOOT, CAL state, DDR state and READY; '?' returns status, 'p' returns PONG and printable 'Z' is echoed. No persistent format, reset/power action, unknown-process stop or residual task process.
failure_policy: Preserve all candidate evidence. If the corrected candidate fails functionally after a proven configuration, restore the content-addressed golden SOF through the same volatile path when safe, without reset/power/Flash, and report the exact first missing marker. Do not retry the same candidate indefinitely.
resource: All preflight, programming, console and optional golden rollback actions hold gamepc. Programmer and terminal are foreground/owned and bounded; return 75 means wait.
forbidden_regions: global jtagserver kill or stopping any pre-existing/unknown process
using an SOF whose bytes/hash differ from T-006 evidence
claiming Linux or full-FP release validation

result.programming: PASS for the exact T-006 SOF; checksum 0x31426358, JTAG ID 0x02E060DD, Configuration succeeded, operation succeeded and programmer exit 0
result.hardware_boot: PASS; LCVEX25 BOOT, CAL-WAIT, DDR-FAIL and READY observed
result.functional_acceptance: FAIL; connected raw, line-buffered, PTY and reference ordinary-file input attempts produced no status/PONG/echo
result.golden_control: PASS for volatile programming and target-to-host output; current no-reset run reached OpenSBI/Linux but not a shell, so current host-input control is inconclusive
result.safety: No JIC/EPCQ/Flash, power or reset action; only task-owned server/terminal PIDs stopped; preexisting standard server PID 5640 preserved
result.next: T-20260920-001 must reproduce the RX gap with vendor-faithful full-SoC timing before any RTL change.

next_after_acceptance: Superseded by the T-20260920-001 RX reproduction/fix task; final board acceptance remains part of the active parent goal.
